parameter: EIA 2.4 Water: process and sanitary effluents treated to the Water Pollution Control Regulation sea-discharge limits
remarks: ALP-EPC-00GNA-PR-SDS-0001 (waste water treatment SDD); ALP-EPC-00GUA-PR-SDS-0001 (sanitary); ALP-EPC-00GMA-PR-SDS-0001 (process drains); ALP-EPC-00000-PR-LST-0003; permits PMT-019, PMT-022.
value_text: Process effluents are collected by the process drains system and treated in the waste water treatment package with neutralisation by acid and caustic dosing (DEC-EPCE-0015); sanitary waste water is treated in a separate package; discharge quality is monitored and checked against the sea-discharge limits of the regulation in reference REF-CONS-0006; storm water discharge consent PMT-022.
